messages:
maria: Heads up — planning Quito onramp with DeepCloud + AndesHost. Need capacity allocations, marketplace SKU, and KMS flow. Target go-live 2024-06-18.
ajay: Timeline noted. What's the immediate ask from partners?
maria: DeepCloud needs SKU + quota allocation in their marketplace. AndesHost is providing GPU nodes (A100x2). Requesting 20 GPUs initially, with room to scale. We sent partner LOI last week; awaiting entitlement confirmation.
tom: Ops Q — which KMS path are we using for CMEK? DeepCloud marketplace often supports CloudKMS and external HSM. Need KMS decision by EOD Fri to hit timeline.
kelsey: :wave: I've looped in legal on marketplace T&Cs for Ecuador. They flagged a data residency clause for logs. CC @natalie for private deployment implications.
natalie: If customers choose Private, we'll need Private onboarding + SOC/audit scoping. I'll estimate support delta.
deploy-bot: capacity-request 2179954321: submitted to infra-quotas. Status: pending.
maria: Can infra grant a hard quota for 20 A100s for Redwood-Dedicated? @tom — also add P95/P99 latency SLOs into quota ticket.
ajay: Adding SLOs now: 99th pct <120ms for 4k tokens, sustained throughput 100 rps. Preference: NVLink-enabled nodes.
tom: AndesHost supports NVLink. We'll need runtime kernel tuning for NVLink + large-batch paths. Eng-runtime: @sasha FYI.
sasha: I can prototype kernel config. What's the perf window?
maria: T-3 weeks to go-live after quota approval. Can you run a perf sweep within 7 days of quota grant?
sasha: Yes. I'll run the standard perf-suite and share artifacts. Planned config snippet to try:
```
runtime.cfg:
  batch_size: 8
  kv_cache_enabled: true
  nvlink: true
  quant: bf16
```

deepcloud: DeepCloud (partner): confirming SKU creation timeline — marketplace SKU ready in 5 business days after contract signature. Need billing contact and legal CC.
maria: We have an MSA signed. Billing contact: finance@redwood.com. Partner, please cc legal@deepcloud on SKU request.
deepcloud: Will do. We'll cc legal and start the SKU flow today.
kelsey: Legal requests logs remain regional until we finish the privacy validation. Can we make telemetry regional by default?
maria: Yes — set telemetry storage to Quito region for initial roll.
tom: I'll create a routing policy to pin regional customers to Quito. Fallback will be eu-west1 if capacity exhausted.
ajay: Marketing wants a joint announcement — 2-week embargo. Need partner sign-off on quote + logos.
marketing-bot: marketing: reminder — draft joint announcement + partner quote due 2024-06-10 for 2024-06-18 launch.
maria: Owners: Infra quotas — @tom; KMS & T&Cs — @kelsey; Partner SKU & billing — @deepcloud; Runtime perf — @sasha; Marketing sync — @natalie. I'll collate a runbook and checklist.
natalie: I'll produce the runbook template + release checklist (comms, monitoring, rollback playbook).
maria: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with a consolidated checklist and cross-post to #eng-runtime and #eng-infra. Thanks all.
calendar-bot: scheduled kickoff meeting 2024-06-02 10:00 AM (Quito local)
